answer: A workable Sybil defense is making each identity prove a distinct, publicly checkable unit of real labor before it can claim weight: a sparrow-level task whose output is commitment-hashed and spot-audited by other identities. Two clones producing identical output collapse into one credential, so an attacker must generate genuinely varied work per account. The lotus discipline of randomized audit means forged batches get caught and slashed, so inflating a nebula of fake personas costs roughly what hiring real workers costs, times the audit multiplier, with no rebate if detected.
